provenance.prompt: Assembled 42 distinct imagegen poses from source parts. Exact prompts, hashes, dates and crop assignments are preserved in sourceParts and generationHistory.

mirrorReview.notes: Canon portrait and gameplay references show Vanta as a pale adult human man with short silver-white curls, dark eyebrows, gray stubble, a broad athletic build and black/crimson basketball kit. The accepted source excludes a fused low-dribble pair and rejects a tattooed generation; accepted frames contain plain natural skin. Source and all five packed clips were reviewed on dark and light backgrounds: 42 complete, distinct human drawings in idle6, idle-ball4, dribble10, run11 and dribble-run11 order. No fixed-side canon trait or directional detail is present, so mirroring preserves his identity.

provenance.coverage: 42 authored poses: idle6, idle-ball4, dribble10, run11 and dribble-run11.

review.source: The 42-body transparent source and all five packed production atlases were reviewed on dark and light backgrounds. The accepted art retains Vanta Slate’s silver-white curls, facial stubble, broad adult human build and black/crimson kit, with no unsupported tattoos. All poses are full-body and distinct, and action order is correct.

assembly.operation: Isolate existing alpha bodies from each listed source part, resize each part uniformly to a shared maximum pose height of 144px, and place originals into a transparent 7x6 grid of 192x192 cells at baseline 184. No new, mirrored, held or repeated poses were created.

sourceParts.cleanup: Composed35 connected figures from33 individually separated bodies in the34-component base candidate plus two separately generated low-dribble drawings. One touching pair in the base dribble row was wholly excluded. The accepted source contains six idle, four ball-ready, ten distinct dribble, eight upright run and seven dribble-run poses. The broad build uses a144px intermediate maximum height to preserve proportions within the192px source cell.
Accepted retry retains seven separated, full-body low dribble-run drawings with plain natural skin and no unsupported tattoos or markings.
Retained four ball-ready poses and three upright running strides as seven full alpha-connected figures.
